payload.title: Review the repository and summarize the Stage 0 deferred issues. Do not modify any files.

outOfScope: fixing the deferred credit-note edit inventory rewrite (that is TASK-0001 / Stage 1)
changing upsertGraph to upsertGraphAndFetch in EditCreditNote.service.ts, or any other candidate fix
changing credit-note edit semantics, including the GL edit path that the same root cause disables
unblocking TASK-0001 (installing the Codex CLI, setting AI_CODEX_BIN, or relaxing reviewer-provider independence)
reconstructing the missing Codex design-review transcript
computing Stage 0 reviewer precision or recall
re-running or modifying the Stage 0 suite or the Stage -1 canonical baseline
opening a new task for the unrecorded GL-on-edit consequence (surface it; the human decides whether it becomes a task)

the Stage 0 design's own outOfScope list (tax, FX, document totals, overapplication, period locking, isolation level, assertBalanced, retries/backoff, async COGS worker, pre-COMMIT enqueue, EE packaging, SMTP/invites, NaN route params)
every path under packages/server/src as a write target
authoring .ai/reports/TASK-0002.md (the orchestrator generates reports from the event log)
invariants: The number of deferred issues reported equals the number of events with type=DEFERRED in .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl, computed at read time, not quoted from a prior summary.

DEFERRED, BACKFILL_GAP, and RUNTIME_EVIDENCE.notVerified / design.outOfScope are reported as three distinct categories and are never summed into a single 'deferred' figure. An evidence gap is not a deferral; an out-of-scope item is not a deferral.
Every factual claim in the summary resolves to an eventId, a commit sha, a report line, or a file:line. No claim originates with the summary author.

Each reported item carries its provenance: all 35 TASK-0000 events are reconstructed, so each cited item states its reconstructionConfidence (HIGH or MEDIUM) rather than presenting reconstruction as primary record.

Consequences of a deferred item that are NOT covered by a test or by recorded runtime evidence are reported at strictly lower confidence than the test-pinned core, and are labelled as unverified extensions rather than folded into the deferral's established scope.

Where the recorded 'why' of a deferral is narrower or wider than what the code shows, the summary reports both the recorded text verbatim AND the code-level finding, and says which is which. It does not silently replace the record with the better explanation.
Each deferred item's current status reflects the repository as it stands at a266b2b35, including the state of any follow-up task that owns it.
The working tree is unchanged: no file is created, modified, or deleted by this task, including files under .ai/.
falsifiablePredictions: grep -c '"type":"DEFERRED"' .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl returns exactly 1. Any other value falsifies the reported deferral count.

That single event is EV-e174e65a8593d391 (seq 32, actor claude-advisor, reconstructionConfidence HIGH) with payload.what == 'credit-note edit inventory rewrite'. A different eventId or subject falsifies the identification.

grep -c '"type":"BACKFILL_GAP"' .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl returns exactly 2 (Codex design-review transcript; reviewer miss rate / precision denominators). A third gap would mean the summary omitted one.

TASK-0001 ('Fix Credit Note inventory edit', risk=high) is in state ESCALATED with an ESCALATION event citing 'independent reviewer unavailable'. If it is READY_TO_MERGE or MERGED, the claim that the deferral is still open and blocked is wrong.

CreditNoteInventoryTransactionsSubscriber.ts:48 contains the guard `if (!creditNote.isOpen) return;` under an @OnEvent(events.creditNote.onEdited, { suppressErrors: false }) handler. If the guard or the suppressErrors:false annotation is gone, the deferral has been silently resolved or regressed.

EditCreditNote.service.ts:64 calls `.upsertGraph(` and NOT `.upsertGraphAndFetch(`, while EditVendorCredit.service.ts:65-71 calls `upsertGraphAndFetch`. This asymmetry is the controlled contrast that makes the unreachability causal rather than correlational. If both now use the same call, the causal account is falsified.

TWO independent terms of `isOpen` fail on edit, not one: CommandCreditNoteDTOTransform.service.ts:82-90 omits `openedAt` when oldCreditNote exists, AND omits refundedAmount/invoicesAmount on every edit. Reverting upstream 76fc32078 alone would therefore NOT make the handler reachable. If restoring the usage columns alone makes isOpen true, the recorded 'why' was sufficient and my narrowing is wrong.

packages/server/test/stage0-final-atomicity.stage0-spec.ts:189 is a live, non-skipped test asserting seen.openedAt === null and seen.isOpen === false (:248-249) after a real credit-note API edit. If those assertions are absent or now expect isOpen true, the summary's core claim is stale.

No test anywhere under packages/server/test asserts anything about GL entry rewriting on a credit-note EDIT. If such a test exists, the GL consequence is verified and belongs in the confirmed section rather than in knownUnverified.

The Stage 0 suite reports 29 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped across six stage0-spec files with zero it.skip/describe.skip/.todo, and the Stage -1 baseline reports 55 clean / 0 regressions. A different count means the recorded acceptance no longer describes this tree.

The events schema enumerates DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP as separate types (.ai/schema/events.schema.json). If they were ever merged into one type, the three-category invariant is unenforceable and this design is wrong.
implementationConstraints: The write allowlist is EMPTY. scopeAllowlist above is a READ allowlist only. Zero file mutations.
No state-mutating git operations: no commit, add, stash, checkout, branch, or merge. Read-only git inspection only.
Do not execute the Stage 0 or Stage -1 suites. At risk=low the recorded RUNTIME_EVIDENCE is cited, not re-derived; the .ai/runs/TASK-0001 logs are read as-is.
Quote DEFERRED and BACKFILL_GAP payload.what and payload.why verbatim. Do not paraphrase a 'why' into a shorter cause.
Do not reconstruct, infer, or invent content for the missing Codex design-review transcript. Its absence is the finding.

Preserve the exact epistemic status of the credit-note item: the inventory handler is proven unreachable on the exercised edit paths and was NOT fixed. Do not restate this as fixed, as a non-issue, or as unknown.

The GL-entries consequence (CreditNoteGLEntriesSubscriber.ts:77 guarding on isPublished, i.e. !!openedAt, and therefore also dead on edit) is reported ONLY under knownUnverified with its file:line and its mechanism. It shares a root cause with the recorded deferral but has no test and no runtime evidence, and it appears in no DEFERRED event. Do not present it as part of what Stage 0 deferred.
Report counts by computing them from the event log, not by copying the 'Observatory counters' block, which is a derived view that could drift.
Distinguish Stage 0's single deferral from Stage 0's four CONFIRMED findings, all of which were fixed and are therefore not deferred.
requiredTests: None. This task produces no code, so it adds no automated tests; asserting otherwise would be scope creep. The falsifiable predictions above ARE the check set, each executable as a grep or jq over .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl, .ai/tasks/TASK-0001/, and the named source and spec files.
If the builder finds itself needing a test, that is a signal the task has drifted out of read-only scope and must stop.
requiredRuntimeAcceptance: git status --porcelain shows no tracked-file modification attributable to this task; the only untracked entry remains .ai/tasks/TASK-0002/.
Recomputed DEFERRED count over .ai/tasks/TASK-0000/events.jsonl matches the count stated in the summary.
Every eventId cited in the summary resolves to a real line in the referenced events.jsonl.
Every commit sha cited resolves via git cat-file -e, and every file:line cited resolves to the quoted text at that line.

The summary presents deferrals, evidence gaps, and not-verified/out-of-scope items under three separately labelled headings with their own counts, plus a fourth clearly-labelled section for unverified extensions.
knownUnverified: GL ENTRIES ON CREDIT-NOTE EDIT. CreditNoteGLEntriesSubscriber.ts:77 guards on isPublished (!!openedAt), which fails on edit by the same mechanism, implying stale GL entries after editing an open credit note. This is NOT in any DEFERRED event, is covered by no test, and has no runtime evidence. It is a plausible same-root-cause extension of the recorded deferral, reported as such and not as established fact. Verifying it requires a real API edit plus GL-row inspection, which this read-only task does not perform.

BLAST RADIUS OF THE RECORDED DEFERRAL. The recorded item names only the inventory rewrite. Whether stale INVENTORY_TRANSACTIONS after an edit cause downstream stock or COGS divergence in practice is asserted from code reading, not measured against a database.

COMPLETENESS OF THE DEFERRAL LIST. All 35 TASK-0000 events are reconstructed, and the observatory did not exist during Stage 0. Deferrals agreed verbally and never written down leave no trace, exactly as BACKFILL_GAP #2 records for findings. The summary can state that ONE deferral is recorded; it cannot state that only one was made.
The missing Codex design-review transcript may have contained further deferrals or scope carve-outs. Unrecoverable by construction.

Whether the credit-note onEdited handler is unreachable on EVERY edit path, or only on the branches the pinning test exercises. The test pins an observation on two branches; universal unreachability is inferred from the transform's conditional spreads, not exhaustively enumerated.

Whether upstream 76fc32078 is the causal origin of the omitted usage columns. This is asserted in commit 0c6c8735b's message and in the transform's comment, and was not independently bisected. Note also that the recorded 'why' attributes the deferral to that commit alone, while the code shows a second independent failing term (omitted openedAt) that predates it.
Whether the recorded 'why' or the narrower upsertGraph/upsertGraphAndFetch account is the one the Stage 0 reviewer actually held. The transcript that would settle it is the missing evidence gap.

Whether the recorded Stage 0 acceptance (29/29 suite, 55 clean baseline, general_log A/R thread trace) still holds at a266b2b35. It was recorded at 0c6c8735b and re-observed only for the suite count in the TASK-0001 run logs; nothing is re-run by this task.
Stage 0 reviewer miss rate, finding precision and recall remain uncomputable. No denominator exists.
The DESIGN_DECISION carrying Stage 0's outOfScope list is reconstructionConfidence MEDIUM, so that 13-item list is the weakest-sourced input to this summary.

Whether TASK-0001's escalation is the sole blocker on the deferral, or whether the Stage 1 semantic decision about credit-note edit behaviour is also unmade. No design artefact for Stage 1 exists in the repository.
